name: Guiding Bolt

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Ranged spell attack Radiant damage; next attack against hit target before end of caster next turn has Advantage; consume exact next-attack grant once; higher slots scale dice.

rules.text: You hurl a bolt of light toward a creature within range.
Make a ranged spell attack against the target.
On a hit, it takes 4d6 Radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage.
The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.
